scope: Direct dataset/document/source-document references in all daily-edit root HTML pages: href, src, data-pdf-preview-src, data-src, data-download-url; filename extensions are listed below. Query strings retained; fragments removed for URL identity. No remote fetches were made. Does not recursively crawl linked GitLab directories, runtime JS, dynamically inserted links, or all embedded datasets. Final local HTML comparison found two newly added Model source-document URLs. Both public GitLab raw files were fetched and matched the archive in full; 179 prior matches retain their saved evidence.
limitations: Full SHA match verifies archived bytes against the cited saved evidence, not a new live HTTP response.
Filename-prefix-only matches are lower-confidence provenance than saved full readback SHA and are labeled separately.
Third-party literature/vendor references need not be redistributed in the team archive; absent archive copies are not claimed as missing team data.
Repository blob pages are source document references, not raw byte-download endpoints.
Retained historical mappings may differ from later organization paths; this report records paths at check time.
